provenance.what_it_is: pureql values of the contract-4.8 analytics Cells of every bond of the coverage input set at every (scen_id, t), computed by tests/helpers/pureql_val.py::pq_analytics (pureql's BondFunctions / CashFlows entry points with explicit settlement dates; the engine clean price with Settings moved), with the model's NT / ERR / Macaulay / zspread policies applied, once per settings variant. Errors are recorded as {error, message}.
